text:
jon: Hands-up: Finance & Ops approved two related billing policy updates. Goal: more predictable developer experience and fewer surprise throttles. We're calling them "Team Credit Pooling" and "Weekday Burst Policy". Enforcement date: 2026-08-01. TL;DR below.

rebekah: Quick ask: product needs exact copy for the Console banner and signup modal.

jon: Summary: 
- Team Credit Pooling: teams with >=3 seats can opt into a pooled free credit bucket. Default pooled monthly credit = 120,000 tokens for qualifying teams. Pooling does NOT change per-user rate limits; it only aggregates monthly free credits. Opt-in in Console.
- Weekday Burst Policy: free and trial accounts keep their existing monthly quota but burst capacity is now limited to weekday business hours (08:00-20:00 UTC). Outside that window bursts will be rate-limited to steady-state. Rationale: reduce global abuse windows and align capacity with support hours.

tim: How do we reflect this in headers/429s? Do we add any new telemetry?

jon: We'll add `x-pool-remaining`, `x-burst-window` and `x-pool-id` headers. Also emit an event `credit_pool_joined` and `burst_window_violation`. No client-breaking changes.

ops-bot: Migration flagged: backfill `pool_opt_in` false for existing teams. Scheduled job 2026-07-15T02:00Z to tag eligible teams.

support-lead: Support needs a playbook: how to explain pooled credits vs paid tiers, and a recovery flow for accounts that hit hard throttle. Also request a 7-day recovery window for suspended free accounts (soft-suspend -> can re-enable via one-click upgrade within 7 days).

rebekah: Product: we'll add an opt-in toggle and a tooltip that says: "Pooling helps teams share free credits; it does not increase per-request concurrency." Also we need copy for team emails when pooling is enabled.

jon: Finance note: pooled credits are still free; we will monitor for abuse and reserve the right to revoke pooling on accounts with anomalous patterns. We'll mirror the existing audit tags `pool_revoked_reason`.

tim: Ops: we'll need a small change in the quota service to prefer using pool tokens before per-account tokens when `pool_opt_in=true`. I'll open an infra ticket and a migration to recompute `monthly_pool_quota`.

support-lead: Also please add a Console CTA that estimates "cost if upgraded now" for teams that exhaust the pool. That should reduce inbound tickets.

jon: Communications plan: internal comms next Monday, targeted email to eligible teams 2026-07-01, public Help Center article on 2026-07-08, enforcement 2026-08-01.

rebekah: Marketing: let's position this as "team-friendly sharing" and include an FAQ about timezones and burst hours. Avoid words like "restriction" where possible.

jon: One more: for accounts with saved billing, we'll show an optional pre-emptive estimate when a team reaches 90% of the pool and offer a one-click topup to cover the next 50k tokens. Topup mechanics similar to existing auto-topup but scoped to team pools.

ops-bot: Reminder: add `pool_topup_attempt` event and schedule invoice preview 2026-08-02T03:00Z for post-enforcement overages.

tim: Thanks all 1 I'll drop the spec link in #eng-infra.

jon: OK folks, tag owners: @rebekah (product), @tim (engineering), @support-lead (support), finance for monitoring. We'll run a dry-run test in staging the week of 2026-07-18. :white_check_mark:
